headline: 0 contract addresses catalogued; R25 website geo-blocked, docs inaccessible, no public deployment manifest found for Pharos or Polygon; rcUSD+ contract address was explicitly not disclosed at launch

findings.text: D1: Pharos chain has no canonical block explorer in the defipunkd-supported chainId list, and no R25 name-tag search could be executed. The protocol's website (r25.xyz) returned a geo-restricted 'Access Restricted' page on direct fetch. No on-chain address surfaced via Pharos explorer search.

D2: docs.r25.xyz returned a permission-denied error ('You don't have permission to access this domain'). No deployed-contracts page could be located. Multiple third-party sources at launch time (Coinspeaker, Bitget News, holder.io) explicitly noted that 'R25's official documentation at docs.r25.xyz and main site at r25.xyz were inaccessible at publication time' and that 'the contract address for rcUSD+ on Polygon was not disclosed.' No deployed_contracts_doc URL could be set.

D3: No audit links were provided in protocol.audit_links and none were discoverable via web search. Third-party coverage from launch (November 2025) explicitly noted 'No security audit reports were accessible.' No audit PDFs found.

D4: No GitHub repository is recorded in protocol.github. Web searches did not surface any R25 GitHub organization or deployment artifact files (broadcast JSON, hardhat-deploy JSON, deployments.md). No contract addresses discoverable via this route.

D5: Protocol.chains lists only 'Pharos.' Pharos mainnet launched April 28, 2026 (Pacific Ocean Mainnet). R25's initial launch was on Polygon (November 14, 2025) per Polygon blog and multiple news sources, but the per-protocol context pins the chain as Pharos. Zero addresses surfaced for either Pharos or Polygon from accessible corpora.
D6: No factory addresses discovered; D6 not applicable as no base addresses were found from D1–D4.
D7: No addresses were catalogued, so no role taxonomy entries are possible.
D8: No addresses were surfaced from any fetched URL; admin_addresses[] is empty. Zero snippet-only sightings of 0x addresses found in any fetched or searched source.

rationale.verdict: All discovery corpora returned zero addresses. The protocol website is geo-blocked, the docs site is access-denied, no GitHub was provided, no audits exist, and multiple press sources from the protocol's November 2025 Polygon launch explicitly noted that the rcUSD+ contract address was not publicly disclosed. The Pharos chain (the pinned chain) is a newly launched mainnet (April 28, 2026) not indexed in defipunkd's supported explorer list, with no public block explorer search available. Discovery is blocked at every source class.

protocol_metadata.about: R25 is an RWA and stablecoin protocol that tokenizes yield-bearing financial instruments for institutional and professional market participants. Its debut product, rcUSD+, is a yield-bearing stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the US dollar and backed by short-duration US Treasury bills, money market funds, and structured notes. The protocol is a member of the Pharos RealFi Alliance and targets deployment on the Pharos Layer-1 blockchain, with an earlier launch on Polygon in November 2025. R25's stated mission is to bridge traditional financial instruments with blockchain-based settlement and programmable yield distribution.
